items.prompt: Sita counts in sevens: 7, 14, 21, 28 and so on. Which of these numbers will she say?

options.why: 85 = 84 + 1, so it is 1 more than a multiple of 7.
86 = 84 + 2, so it is not in the 7 times table.
87 = 84 + 3, so it is not in the 7 times table.
88 = 84 + 4, so it is not in the 7 times table.

hints: She says only numbers in the 7 times table.
70 = 7 × 10 is a handy place to start.
Count on in sevens from 70: 77, then the next one.
items.explanation: Counting on from 70 gives 77, 84, 91 and so on. 84 = 7 × 12 is in the 7 times table, and 85 to 88 are not.

items.prompt: In the pattern 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, the jumps grow by 1 each time. What is the 10th number?

options.why: 37 is the 9th number. One more jump is needed.
Start from 1, not 0. Add the jumps 1 to 9 to the first number.
55 is the sum of 1 to 10. The 10th number needs only 9 jumps.
56 is the 11th number.

hints: Write down the jumps.
The jumps are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and so on.
The 10th number is 1 plus the first 9 jumps.
items.explanation: The 10th number is the 1st number plus 9 jumps: 1 + (1 + 2 + 3 + ... + 9) = 1 + 45 = 46.

solution.say: The jumps are 1, 2, 3, and so on.
From the 1st to the 10th number there are 9 jumps.

items.prompt: Odd numbers are written in rows. Row 1 is 1. Row 2 is 3, 5. Row 3 is 7, 9, 11. Each row has one more number than the row before. What is the sum of the numbers in row 6?

head: Row
Numbers
figure.alt: Rows of odd numbers. Row 1: 1. Row 2: 3, 5. Row 3: 7, 9, 11. Row 4: 13, 15, 17, 19.

options.why: 64 is the sum of row 4.
125 is the sum of row 5.
225 is the sum of rows 1 to 5 together.

hints: Find the numbers in row 6.
Rows 1 to 5 hold 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 = 15 odd numbers.
Row 6 starts at the 16th odd number, which is 31.
items.explanation: Rows 1 to 5 use the first 15 odd numbers, so row 6 is 31, 33, 35, 37, 39, 41. Their sum is 216. The row sums 1, 8, 27, 64, 125, 216 also follow a pattern: 6 × 6 × 6 = 216.

items.prompt: The word MANGO is written again and again: MANGOMANGOMANGO and so on. What is the 2026th letter?

options.why: A is in places that are 2 more than a multiple of 5.
N is in places that are 3 more than a multiple of 5.
G is in places that are 4 more than a multiple of 5.

hints: MANGO has 5 letters, so the pattern repeats every 5 letters.
Letters 5, 10, 15, and so on are all O.
2025 is a multiple of 5. Which letter comes right after an O?
items.explanation: 2025 = 5 × 405, so the 2025th letter is O, the end of a group. The 2026th letter starts a new group, so it is M.

solution.say: The 2025th letter is O. The next one starts a new group.

items.prompt: The pattern 3, 7, 11, 15 keeps going up by 4. How many of its numbers are less than 200?
hints: Each number is 1 less than a multiple of 4.
Find the biggest number of this kind that is still less than 200.
items.explanation: The numbers are 4 - 1, 8 - 1, 12 - 1, and so on. The last one below 200 is 200 - 1 = 199, which is 4 × 50 - 1. So there are 50 numbers.

solution.say: Write each number as a multiple of 4, minus 1.
The next one, 203, is too big. So there are 50 numbers.

items.prompt: A bakery bakes bread every 3 days and cakes every 4 days. Both were baked on 1 March. On which date will both be baked again for the first time?

options.why: On 7 March only bread is baked. Cakes are baked on 5 and 9 March.
12 is the number of days to wait, not the date.
Both are baked on 25 March, but they meet earlier too.

hints: List the bread days and the cake days.
Bread days are 3 apart and cake days are 4 apart, starting from 1 March.
The wait is the smallest number that both 3 and 4 divide into.
items.explanation: Both are baked again after a number of days that both 3 and 4 divide into. The smallest is 12, so the next date is 1 + 12 = 13 March.

solution.say: The gap is 12 days because 12 is the smallest multiple of both 3 and 4.

items.prompt: What is the next number in this pattern?

figure.alt: A pattern: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, then an empty box.

hints: Look at the jumps between the numbers.
The jumps are 4, 6, 8, 10.
Also try writing each number as two numbers multiplied: 2 = 1 × 2, 6 = 2 × 3.
items.explanation: The jumps are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next jump is 12 and the next number is 30 + 12 = 42. Also, each number is a number times the next one: 6 × 7 = 42.

items.prompt: Matchsticks make a grid of squares that is 2 rows high. With 1 column (2 squares) it uses 7 matchsticks. With 2 columns (4 squares) it uses 12. How many squares can be made with 52 matchsticks?

figure.alt: A grid of matchstick squares, 2 rows high and 2 columns wide. It uses 12 matchsticks and makes 4 squares.

hints: How many matchsticks does each new column add?
From 7 to 12 is 5. Each new column adds 5 matchsticks.
After the first column, 52 - 7 = 45 matchsticks are left.
items.explanation: The first column uses 7 matchsticks and each new column adds 5. The other 45 matchsticks make 9 more columns, so there are 10 columns of 2 squares: 20 squares.

solution.say: Each new column adds 3 across and 2 up.

items.prompt: In a year that is not a leap year, 1 January is a Monday. What is the date of the third Friday in March?
hints: Find the day of the week for 1 March.
January has 31 days and February has 28. So 1 March is 59 days after 1 January.
59 days is 8 weeks and 3 days.
items.explanation: 1 March is 59 days after 1 January, which is 8 weeks and 3 days, so it is a Thursday. The first Friday is 2 March, the second 9 March and the third 16 March.

items.prompt: Look at the numbers 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16. Each time the jump gets bigger by 1. What number comes next?
hints: Write the jumps between the numbers.
The jumps are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
The next jump is 6.
items.explanation: The jumps are 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5, so the next jump is 6. 16 + 6 = 22.

items.prompt: A pattern repeats these four shapes: triangle, circle, square, circle. Which shape is the 30th?
hints: Find how many shapes make one repeat.
The pattern repeats every 4 shapes. Divide 30 by 4.
30 ÷ 4 is 7 remainder 2. Which shape is second in the group?
items.explanation: The group of 4 shapes repeats. 30 = 7 × 4 + 2, so the 30th shape is the second in the group, which is a circle.

options.why: The triangle is in position 1, 5, 9, ... which are 1 more than a multiple of 4. 30 is not.
The square is in position 3, 7, 11, ... which are 3 more than a multiple of 4. 30 is not.
There is no star in the pattern.
The pattern repeats every 4 shapes, so we can work out any position.

items.prompt: Add up the first 12 odd numbers: 1 + 3 + 5 + ... Look for a pattern in the first few sums. What is the total?
hints: Work out 1, then 1 + 3, then 1 + 3 + 5.
The sums are 1, 4, 9, 16, ...
These are square numbers. The 12th odd number sum is 12 × 12.
items.explanation: The sum of the first 2 odd numbers is 4, of 3 is 9, of 4 is 16. The sum of the first n odd numbers is n × n. So for 12, it is 144.

items.prompt: A row of squares is made from matchsticks. One square uses 4 matchsticks. Two joined squares use 7. Three use 10. How many matchsticks make a row of 12 squares?
hints: Find how many sticks each new square adds.
Each new square adds 3 sticks.
Start with 4 and add 3 eleven more times.
items.explanation: The first square needs 4 sticks and each of the 11 extra squares needs 3 more. 4 + 11 × 3 = 37 matchsticks.

items.prompt: Write the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 again and again: 123456123456... What is the sum of the first 50 digits?
hints: Add the digits in one group of 6.
One group of 1 to 6 makes 21.
50 = 8 groups of 6 plus 2 extra digits.
items.explanation: Each full group of six digits adds up to 21. There are 8 full groups (48 digits), which give 168. The next two digits are 1 and 2, so 168 + 3 = 171.

items.prompt: A staircase has 1 block in step 1, 2 blocks in step 2, 3 in step 3, and so on. How many blocks are in a staircase with 9 steps?
hints: Write the number of blocks in each step.
Pair 1 with 9, 2 with 8, and so on.
items.explanation: Pairs make 10: 1 + 9, 2 + 8, 3 + 7 and 4 + 6, and 5 is left. 4 × 10 + 5 = 45 blocks.

items.prompt: Day 1 of a camp is a Monday. The camp lasts 100 days. What day of the week is day 100?
hints: The days repeat every 7 days.
Count how many days pass from day 1 to day 100.
99 ÷ 7 is 14 remainder 1.
items.explanation: Day 100 is 99 days after day 1. 99 = 14 × 7 + 1, so the day is 1 day after Monday, which is Tuesday.

options.why: Day 99 is a Monday since 98 is 14 weeks later, so day 100 is one day further.
Day 100 is 99 days after day 1, which is 14 weeks plus 1 day, not 2 days.
Day 100 is only 1 day past a whole number of weeks.
Sunday is the day before Monday, which is the wrong direction.
